  "explanation": "The request is accepted as an upward reserve sizing study for ERCO with a 60-minute horizon, cost_reserve=1.0, and cost_shortfall=20.0. Only observed weather and lagged load are admitted as issue-time information; future load, future weather, realized targets, and test-period residuals are forbidden.     "fabricated_result",

    "future_weather",
    "raw_data_modification",
    "realized_target",
    "test_period_residual"

  "reason": "The operator request maps to the allowed upward_reserve_sizing task with supported region ERCO, one-hour horizon interpreted as 60 minutes, and allowed shortfall cost 20.0. The requested information set is consistent with the decision-time boundary and excludes future information and test-residual leakage.",
  "study_schema": {
    "task_type": "upward_reserve_sizing",
    "region_id": "ERCO",
    "horizon_minutes": 60,
    "cost_reserve": 1.0,
    "cost_shortfall": 20.0,
    "rolling_window": {
      "train_days": 730,
      "cal_days": 30,
      "test_days": 30,
      "rolling_step_days": 30

    "requires_human_approval": true
  },
  "workflow": [

    "configure_rolling_window_train_730_cal_30_test_30_step_30",
    "run_verified_numerical_workflow_for_upward_reserve_sizing",
    "route_results_to_human_approval"
  ]
}
